definitions.explanation: A predetermined or fixed amount or quantity of something.
Relating to or involving the measurement of quantity, as opposed to quality. Used in scientific and technical contexts.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎日|まいにち}→毎日：00729_mainichi⟧{定量|ていりょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drink a fixed amount of water every day.

examples.japanese: ⟦{薬|くすり}→薬：00793_kusuri⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定量|ていりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}って→守る：01986_mamoru⟧⟦{服用|ふくよう}して→服用する：21605_fukuyousuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Please take the medicine in the prescribed amount.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出|で}る→出る：00513_deru⟧。
examples.english: Exceeding the fixed quantity affects quality.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{成分|せいぶん}→成分：04344_seibun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{割合|わりあい}→割合：01760_wariai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べた→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧。
examples.english: We investigated the proportion of components through quantitative analysis.

examples.japanese: {定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}な⟦データ→データ：03944_deeta⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{基|もと}づいて→基づく：02315_motozuku⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: We make decisions based on quantitative data.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{研究|けんきゅう}→研究：01396_kenkyuu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}な⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{定性|ていせい}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧な⟦{手法|しゅほう}→手法：12762_shuhou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{両方|りょうほう}→両方：01750_ryouhou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{用|もち}いた→用いる：02314_mochiiru⟧。
examples.english: This research used both quantitative and qualitative methods.

notes:
Composed of {定|てい} (fixed, determined) + ⟦{量|りょう}→量：03799_ryou⟧ (quantity, amount). Has two main uses: (1) a set or prescribed amount, and (2) the concept of "quantitative" in scientific and analytical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定量|ていりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧: follow the prescribed amount
- {定量|ていりょう}⟦{分析|ぶんせき}→分析：03610_bunseki⟧: quantitative analysis
- {定量|ていりょう}{的|てき}: quantitative (adjectival form)
- {定量|ていりょう}⟦{調査|ちょうさ}→調査：03489_chousa⟧: quantitative survey

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {定性|ていせい}: qualitative (the counterpart to {定量|ていりょう})
- ⟦{適量|てきりょう}→適量：14383_tekiryou⟧: appropriate amount
- ⟦{分量|ぶんりょう}→分量：05474_bunryou⟧: quantity, dose (of ingredients or medicine)
- ⟦{数量|すうりょう}→数量：05473_suuryou⟧: quantity, number (general counting)
